content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：请不要给基础技能附魔奇怪的词条第一卷：冒险者第548章“简单”的攻防战（..la）“轰！”
一支元素箭矢在龙喉身前一米处炸开。
混杂着风雷元素向外翻卷，撞上祖灵防线，震得周围几名混血圣职者脚下不稳。
可龙喉本人没有受伤。
甚至没有做出闪避动作。
就在箭矢即将触及他身体时，其身后那具史诗大灵忽然转过头。
它比龙喉更早发现了危险。
祖灵抬起覆盖着墨绿色鳞片的手臂，横在龙喉身前。
下一瞬，箭矢撞上鳞片。
爆炸声这才响起。
墨绿色鳞片被炸出一道道裂纹，边缘也多了一层焦黑。可图腾法阵内的力量涌来，裂纹转眼便开始合拢。
龙喉直到这时才猛地回头。
暗金色的竖瞳越过混乱的人群，直直落在维克多身上。
很显然。
在爆炸发生之前，他根本不知道自己遭到了偷袭。
那支箭矢上裹着【天时弓术·无迹之幕】。
弓弦震动、元素波动、箭矢破空声，甚至箭锋上那点最难隐藏的杀意，都被压到了最低。
再加上【大隐于市·契中人】的掩护，箭矢混入了第六层台地上四处奔涌的斗气与法术的光辉中。
直到距离龙喉只剩下一米，箭矢依旧像一道无关紧要的战斗余波。
可那具祖灵还是发现了。

“啧。”
“难弄啊这个东西。”
维克多放下星百万，挠了挠头。
史诗大灵与龙喉并不完全共用同一套感知。
龙喉发现不了的东西，它却能发现。
这就相当于身后常年跟着一个不需要吃饭、不需要睡觉，还能三百六十度盯着周围的贴身护卫。
想要偷袭，难度不是一般的大。
维克多没有继续射箭。
他的视线越过战场，看向悬浮在第六层中央仪式环上方的女神投影。
原本由纯白圣光组成的裙摆，此刻已经几乎全数变成了猩红色。
红色还在向上爬。
速度不算快，却一直没有停下。
【瞳术】的视界中，整座圣·佩德罗城已经被无数光线连在了一起。
七层台地上的氏族图腾就是一个个节点。
金白色的圣光从圣职者体内被强行抽出，沿着道路、石阶和建筑墙面向图腾汇聚。
经过图腾以后，圣光染上各个氏族的兽纹，再流入第六层的中央仪式环。
那些力量最后都会经过【勒拿九头蛇的毒血】，化成猩红色的邪崇能量。
龙喉的思路，其实不难猜。

Recommended reading for all book lovers: Please do not enchant basic skills with strange entries Volume 1: Adventurer Chapter 548 "Simple" Attack and Defense Battle (..la) "Boom!"
An elemental arrow exploded one meter in front of Dragon Throat.
Mixed with wind and thunder elements, it rolled outwards and hit the ancestral defense line, shaking several mixed-blood priests around them unsteadily.
But Dragonmaw himself was not injured.
Didn't even make a dodge move.
Just when the arrow was about to touch his body, the epic spirit behind him suddenly turned its head.
It detected danger earlier than Dragonmaw.
The ancestral spirit raised its arm covered with dark green scales and placed it in front of Dragon Throat.
The next moment, the arrow hit the scales.
Only then did the explosion sound.
The dark green scales were blasted with cracks, and the edges also had a layer of burnt black. But the power within the totem circle surged in, and the cracks began to close in an instant.
Only then did Longmaw suddenly turn his head.
Dark golden vertical pupils passed through the chaotic crowd and landed directly on Victor.
Obviously.
Before the explosion, he had no idea he was being attacked.
That arrow was wrapped with [Tianshi Archery: Traceless Curtain].
The vibration of the bowstring, the fluctuation of elements, the sound of arrows breaking through the air, and even the most difficult-to-conceal killing intent on the arrow's edge were all suppressed to a minimum.
Coupled with the cover of [Hidden in the City·The Contracted Man], the arrows were mixed into the brilliance of fighting spirit and spells flowing everywhere on the sixth floor platform.
Until there was only one meter left from the dragon's throat, the arrow was still like an insignificant aftermath of the battle.
But the ancestral spirit was still discovered.
"Tsk."
"This thing is difficult to get."
Victor put down the Star Million and scratched his head.
Epic Great Spirit and Dragonmaw don't exactly share the same set of perceptions.
Dragon Maw can find things that it can't find.
This is equivalent to following a personal guard behind you all year round who doesn't need to eat or sleep, and can stare at the surroundings at 360 degrees.
It's not that difficult to make a sneak attack.
Victor did not continue shooting.
He looked across the battlefield to the goddess projection suspended above the central ritual ring on the sixth floor.
The hem of the skirt, which was originally composed of pure white holy light, has almost completely turned into scarlet at this moment.
The red is still creeping up.
The speed was not very fast, but it never stopped.
In the field of vision of [Eye Technique], the entire city of San Pedro has been connected by countless rays of light.
The clan totems on the seven-story platform are nodes.
The golden-white holy light was forcibly extracted from the body of the priest, and converged on the totem along the roads, stone steps and building walls.
After passing through the totem, the holy light is dyed with the animal patterns of each clan, and then flows into the central ritual ring on the sixth floor.
Those powers will eventually pass through the poisonous blood of the Lena Hydra and turn into scarlet evil energy.
Dragon Maw's thinking is actually not difficult to guess.
